Name: Universal Fishing
Author: yogiero
Description:
[size=5][b]Short Summary[/b][/size]

Adds an adjustable universal pool of vanilla rod-caught fish, so eligible fish can appear outside their usual season, weather, time, and location. Defaults to a 25% universal pool rate and includes the five original Legendary Fish with a one-catch limit. (Excludes crab pot catches.)

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds vanilla rod-caught fish to a universal pool, so they can be caught outside their normal conditions.[/*]
[*]Keeps the usual vanilla pool as the default 75% share and sets the universal pool to 25% by default.[/*]
[*]Includes the five original Legendary Fish with a one-catch limit.[/*]
[*]Excludes crab-pot-only catches and Legendary Fish II.[/*]
[*]Offers an in-game enable/disable switch and Universal Fish Rate setting through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Install it to change settings in-game; without it, edit the mod's config.json with the game closed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download and extract [i]Universal Fishing 1.0.5.zip[/i] into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure the extracted folder is [font=Courier New]Mods/UniversalFishing[/font] and contains [font=Courier New]manifest.json[/font] and [font=Courier New]UniversalFishing.dll[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Open the in-game Options menu and choose Universal Fishing in GMCM.
[list]
[*][b]Enable Universal Fishing:[/b] turns the universal pool on or off.[/*]
[*][b]Universal Fish Rate:[/b] sets the combined chance for the universal pool. It starts at 25% and can be adjusted from 0% to 100% in 5% steps.[/*]
[/list]

[b]AI disclosure:[/b] AI tools generated the mod's core C# code. The promotional images and this page description were also created with AI.

[size=5][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This release targets vanilla fish data; it does not add custom fish from other mods to the universal pool.[/*]
[*]The five original Legendary Fish have a one-catch limit. Legendary Fish II are excluded.[/*]
[*]Fishing behavior and compatibility can vary when other mods change the same fish data[/*]
[/list]
